expects.query: Our RT-VLM GPU averages 42% utilization. During every idle interval, the vLLM scheduler queue is empty and instrumentation shows no eligible work waiting in media arrival, decode, preprocessing, or engine submission. Identify the performance bubble and tell me what to optimize.
checks: The response defines a runtime bubble as idle or low-occupancy GPU time while eligible work is queued.
The response does not diagnose a scheduler, kernel, prefill, or decode bug from average GPU utilization alone.
The response classifies the observation as insufficient offered load and recommends a controlled higher-concurrency replay with unchanged workload shape before optimization.
